description: This file contains a PHP class 'SaveOAuthClientController' that extends an abstract controller and manages the 'preRender' logic for an OAuth client save operation in a web application. It sets up a Vue.js component with properties based on request parameters.

classes.name: SaveOAuthClientController
classes.description: A controller class for saving OAuth clients that prepares a Vue.js component with optional 'id' property based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component by creating an 'oauth-client-save' component and adding an 'id' property if provided in the request query.
